title: Plastic Clothes Pegs with Strong Springs, Pack of 48
description:
Sturdy pegs that grip firmly on the line without leaving marks on most fabrics. A mixed pack of bright colours for laundry days indoors or out.
• 48 pegs, 7.5 cm long
• UV-stabilised polypropylene with stainless steel springs
• Ridged non-slip grip for towels, bedding and clothes
• Also handy for sealing snack bags

title: Drawstring Bin Bags 35 L, 100 Bags
description:
Strong, leak-resistant bin bags with built-in drawstrings that close and carry easily. Sized for most kitchen bins.
• 100 bags on 5 rolls, 35 litres each
• Size: 55 × 60 cm, 20 µm thick
• Made with 70% recycled polyethylene
• Drawstring handles for easy tying and lifting

title: Dual-Sided Scrub Sponges for Dishes, Pack of 12
description:
Everyday kitchen sponges with a soft, absorbent side for wiping and a scouring side for stuck-on food. The scouring pad is gentle on most pots, plates and worktops.
• 12 sponges, 9 × 6 × 3 cm each
• Polyurethane foam with a non-scratch scouring pad
• Rinse and air-dry between uses
• Assorted colours to keep kitchen and bathroom sponges apart

title: Plastic Laundry Basket with Handles, 40 L
description:
A lightweight, ventilated laundry basket for carrying washing to the machine or the line. The moulded handles are comfortable to grip, even when it is full.
• Capacity 40 L; size 58 × 40 × 26 cm
• Durable polypropylene with ventilation slots
• Stackable when empty
• Wipe clean

title: Digital Bathroom Scale with Tempered Glass Platform, 180 kg
description:
A slim, easy-to-read bathroom scale with a large backlit display and precise sensors. Just step on and it switches on automatically.
• Capacity 180 kg in 100 g steps; kg, lb and st units
• 6 mm tempered glass platform, 30 × 30 cm
• Auto on/off with low-battery and overload indicators
• 2 × AAA batteries included

title: Stainless Steel Manicure and Pedicure Set, 10 Pieces
description:
A complete grooming kit for hands and feet in a compact zip case. Sharp, precise tools for neat nails at home or on the go.
• Includes fingernail and toenail clippers, nail scissors, cuticle nipper, slanted tweezers, nail file, cuticle pusher, cuticle trimmer, nail cleaner and brow scissors
• Stainless steel tools
• PU leather zip case, 11 × 7.5 cm
• Wipe tools clean after each use

title: Microfibre Hair Towel Wrap, Pack of 2
description:
A soft, absorbent hair wrap that soaks up water quickly with less rubbing than a regular towel. The button and loop keep it in place while you get ready.
• Pack of 2, each 65 × 25 cm
• Highly absorbent microfibre
• Elastic loop and button fastening
• Machine washable at 40 °C

title: Ultrasonic Aroma Diffuser 300 ml with Ambient Light, USB-C
description:
A quiet ultrasonic diffuser that releases a fine, cool mist with a few drops of your favourite essential oil. A soft seven-colour light sets a relaxing mood in bedrooms and living rooms.
• 300 ml water tank, up to 8 hours on continuous mode
• Automatic shut-off when the water runs low
• 7-colour light that can be dimmed or switched off
• Powered by USB-C; cable included (no plug)

title: Buckwheat Meditation Cushion, Round 40 cm
description:
A firm floor cushion filled with buckwheat hulls that shape to you as you sit. Ideal for meditation, yoga or simply sitting comfortably on the floor.
• Diameter 40 cm, height 15 cm
• Removable cotton cover with zip, machine washable at 30 °C
• Filling: natural buckwheat hulls, adjustable
• Carry handle on the side

title: Brass Singing Bowl Set with Wooden Mallet and Cushion
description:
A hammered brass singing bowl that gives a long, resonant tone when struck or circled with the wooden mallet. A peaceful addition to yoga, meditation or quiet moments at home.
• Bowl diameter 10 cm, height 5 cm
• Brass alloy with a hand-hammered finish
• Includes wooden mallet and fabric cushion
• Presented in a gift box

title: Himalayan Salt Lamp with Wooden Base and Dimmer, EU Plug
description:
A hand-carved pink salt crystal lamp that gives off a warm amber glow. The inline dimmer adjusts the brightness from a soft night light to a cosy glow.
• Weight 2–3 kg, height approx. 18–22 cm (every lamp is unique)
• Wooden base with E14 bulb holder; 2 × 15 W bulbs included
• 1.8 m cable with inline dimmer switch and EU plug
• Salt attracts moisture: keep in a dry room and wipe with a dry cloth

title: Weekly Pill Organiser with 7 Daily Compartments
description:
A simple 7-day organiser that makes it easy to sort and keep track of daily tablets. Each day has its own snap-shut lid marked with a large letter.
• 7 compartments, each 3.5 × 2.5 × 2 cm
• BPA-free plastic with easy-open lids
• Days printed in large, easy-to-read letters
• Compact 19 × 4 × 2.5 cm size for bags and travel

title: Handheld Magnifying Glass 3×, 90 mm Glass Lens
description:
A large, clear glass lens for reading small print on labels, maps, newspapers and instructions. The comfortable handle and light frame make it easy to hold for longer.
• Lens: 90 mm optical glass, 3× magnification
• Overall length 23 cm, weight 140 g
• Metal frame with non-slip handle
• Includes microfibre cleaning cloth and pouch

title: Wooden Step Stool with Non-Slip Feet, 23 cm
description:
A sturdy little step stool for reaching high shelves and cupboards, or for use as a footrest. Solid wood with a smooth, sanded finish.
• Size: 40 × 22 × 23 cm (L × W × H)
• Solid pine, maximum load 120 kg
• Rubber feet help prevent slipping
• Arrives fully assembled

title: Empty First Aid Bag with Labelled Compartments, 2 L
description:
A compact, water-resistant bag for building your own first aid kit for home, car or travel. Clear inner pockets keep supplies organised and easy to find.
• Size: 20 × 14 × 8 cm, approx. 2 L
• Water-resistant 600D polyester with a reflective strip
• Elastic loops and clear mesh pockets inside
• Belt loop and carry handle; supplied empty, contents not included

title: First Aid Storage Box with Handle and Removable Tray
description:
A sturdy plastic box with a lift-out tray that keeps household first aid supplies tidy and together. The printed cross symbol makes it easy to spot in a hurry.
• Size: 33 × 18 × 16 cm
• Durable polypropylene with snap-lock latches
• Lift-out tray with 6 small compartments
• Fold-down carry handle; supplied empty, contents not included

title: Contoured Memory Foam Pillow with Washable Cover
description:
A memory foam pillow with a gentle contour that cradles the head and neck for side and back sleepers. The breathable cover zips off for washing.
• Size: 60 × 35 cm, height 11 cm and 9 cm on the two sides
• Slow-rebound memory foam, 50 kg/m³ density
• Bamboo-viscose blend cover, machine washable at 40 °C
• Air out for 24 hours after unpacking

title: Soft Satin Sleep Mask with Adjustable Strap
description:
A smooth, lightweight eye mask that blocks out light at home, on planes or during daytime naps. Soft padding sits comfortably without pressing on the eyes.
• Polyester satin outer and lining with soft fibre padding
• Size 20 × 9 cm with adjustable elastic strap
• Contoured nose bridge to reduce light leaks
• Comes with a matching travel pouch

title: Hot Water Bottle 2 L with Knitted Cover
description:
A classic hot water bottle in a cosy cable-knit cover for warming up chilly beds and sofa evenings. The ribbed rubber body holds its warmth for hours.
• Capacity 2 litres; size 33 × 20 cm
• Natural rubber body with screw stopper
• Removable knitted acrylic cover
• Fill with hot, not boiling, water to no more than two-thirds full

title: Hollowfibre Pillows 48 × 74 cm, Pair
description:
Plump, medium-firm pillows with a soft microfibre cover and springy hollowfibre filling that keeps its shape night after night. A comfortable choice for all sleeping positions.
• Size: 48 × 74 cm, pack of 2
• Filling: 800 g siliconised hollowfibre per pillow
• Cover: soft-touch microfibre with piped edges
• Machine washable at 40 °C
